s: puM, (aBi + Sap + GaY vfdDiH .) svarRasteyaMtvayA kftamityAdimiTyAdUzaRaM vAkyaM । miTyApavAdaH । tatparyyAyaH । miTyABiSaMsanaM 2 । ityamaraH ॥ kroDAt dvijAdiBirduHKABiDAraRaM । iti purARaM ॥ brAhmaRaguruvfdDasidDAnAM anizwABiSaMsanaM । iti vijayarakzitaH ॥ (“yasyABiSApAt duHKArtto duHKaM vindati nEzaDaH” । iti nalopAKyAne .)
v: aBi(BI)SApa
pu॰ aBi + Sapa--GaY vA dIrGaH । 1 miTyApavAdakaTane 2 AropitadozakaTane 3 anizwaM te BUyAdityAkroSe ca “veda miTyABiSApAstaM na spfSanti kadAcana” ha॰ vaM॰ ।
m: अभि-शाप m. curse, Nir. &c.
charge, accusation, Yājñ. ii, 12 and 99 (cf. अभी-शाप and मिथ्याभिशाप)
false accusation, calumny, L.

k.v: अभिशापः प्रणादस्तु शब्दः स्यादनुरागजः। यशः कीर्तिः समज्ञा च स्तवः स्तोत्रं स्तुतिर्नुतिः॥

m: अभि-शाप—ज्वर m. fever caused by a curse (cf. अभि-शस्तक at end.)
अभि-शापन n. pronouncing a curse, L.
a: अभिशापनं — Pronouncing a curse.

m: अभि-√ शास् -शासति, to assign, allot, RV. vi, 54, 2; to rule, govern, MBh. xiii, 4582.
अभि-शास्तृ mfn. one who assigns, allots, TBr.
1. अभि-√ 1. शी to lie upon (acc.), ŚBr.
2. अभि-√ 3. शी (Imper. 3. sg. Ā. -शीयताम्) to fall down upon, TBr.
अभि-शीन or अभि-श्यान, mfn. coagulated, congealed, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 26.
a: अभिशीन, --श्यान — a. Congealed, coagulated.

m: अभि-शीत or अभि-श्यात mfn. (√ श्यै), cold, chilly, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 26, Kāś.
a: अभिशीत, --श्यात — [श्यै-क्त] a. Cold, chilly, as wind.

m: अभि-शौरि ind. towards Śauri or (Kṛṣṇa)

a: अभिशंक् — {c1c} A. To doubt, mistrust, suspect, be suspicious of (with acc. of person or thing); माभिशंकीर्वचो मम Mb.; Mk. 9. 8; Ms. 8. 96; also with abl.; be afraid of; Bk. 6. 2.
अभिशंका — Doubt, suspicion, apprehension, fear, alarm, anxiety.
अभिशंकित — p. p. Doubtful, suspicious, apprehensive.

m: अभि-√ शंस् to accuse, blame, calumniate, TS. &c.; (2. sg. -शंससि; ind.p. -शस्य) to praise, R. ii, 11, 16 and 23, 8.
a: अभिशंस् — {c1c} P. 1 To blame, accuse, charge, calumniate, defame, traduce; महापापोपपापाभ्यां योऽ भिशंसेन्मृषा परं Y. 3. 286. --2 To praise, extol.

m: अभि-शंसक mfn. accusing, L.
insulting, L.
a: अभिशंसक, --शंसिन् — a. Accusing, charging, calumniating, insulting, abusive; Y. 3. 285.

v: aBiSaMsana

na॰ ABimuKyena SaMsanamAkroSavacanaM vAropyApavAdaSca । samakzamAkoSarUpe pAruzyakaTane 1 ayaM cOra” ityAdinA 2 miTyApavAde ca “SataM brAhmaRamAkruSye” tyupakramya “paYcASadbrAhmaRo daRqyaH kzatriyasyABiSaMsane iti vAkpAruzye “aBiSaMsanaprayegAttayostulyArTatvam “svaBAryyAntu yadA kroDAdagamyeti naro vadet” yA॰ vyAKyAyAM svaBAryyABiSaMsanamiti vijYAneSvareRoktam । 3 ABimuKyena kaTanamAtre ca “SataM strIdUzaRe dadyAt dve tu miTyABiSaMsane” iti yAjYa॰ ।
m: अभि-शंसन n. accusation
insult (with gen.), Mn. vlii, 268
‘accusation’ ifc. e.g. अनृताभिशंसन [Gaut.] or मिथ्याभिशंसन [Yājñ. ii, 289] a false accusation.
a: अभिशंसनं — Accusation, charge, (whether true or false); मिथ्या˚ Y. 2. 289; abuse, insult, affront; पंचाशद् ब्राह्मणो दंड्यः क्षत्रियस्याभिशंसने Ms. 8. 268.

v: aBiSaMsin
tri॰ aBi + Sansa--Rini । 1 samakzamAkroSake 2 apavAdavAkyaprayoktari ca “miTyABiSaMsino dozo dviguRo'nftavAdina” iti yA॰ ।
m: अभि-शंसिन् See मिथ्याभिशंसिन्.

अभि-√ शङ्क् Ā. (rarely P., e.g. aor. Subj. 2. sg. -शङ्कीः, MBh. v, 5000 : but Ā. -शङ्किथाः, MBh. iii, 1166) to doubt, suspect (with acc.; rarely with gen., e.g. Mn. viii, 96), have doubts about (acc.; rarely gen., e.g. MBh. v, 6078).

v: aBiSaNkA

strI aBi + SaNka--BAve a । 1 sarvaTA SaNkane 2 saMSaye 3 Brame ca । “upeyuzI kalpalatABiSaNkayA” kirA॰ “kalpalatABiSaNkayA kalpalatABrameRa” malli॰ । saMSayasya sTARurvAnaroveti uBayakowijYAnarUpatve'pi tadIyAyaTArTakowivizayatvena Bramasya tadIyEkatarakowivizayakatvAt taTAtvam । ayaYca miTyABUtakowimevAvagAhate iti viSezaH । karttari ac । 2 sarvataH SaNkite tri॰ ।
m: अभि-शङ्का f. suspicion (with gen.), R.
apprehension, fear, Kathās.
अभि-शङ्किन् mfn. doubting, suspecting, MBh.

v: aBiSaNkita
tri॰ spaBi + SaNka--kta । 1 sandigDe 2 BrAnte ca ।
m: अभि-शङ्कित mfn. having doubts
suspecting
being alarmed, being in solicitude (v.l. अति-शङ्कित), Hariv.; Bhaṭṭ.
अभि-शङ्कितम् ind. (अन्- neg.) without fear or shyness, MārkP.
अभि-शङ्क्य mfn. suspicious, MBh. iii, 1167
(अन्- neg.), MBh. ii, 190.
अभि-शब्दय Nom. P. (pr. p. ˚यत्) to name, call, ĀśvŚr. : Pass. -शब्द्यते, to be called, MārkP.

v: aBiSabdita
tri॰ ABimuKyena SabditaH । 1 samakzamAhUte 2 samakzakaTite ca ।
m: अभि-शब्दित mfn. announced, mentioned, Mn. vi, 82
named, MBh.; Suśr.
a: अभिशब्दित — a. Declared, announced, said, named.

m: अभि-√ शम् -शाम्यति, to be calmed, cease, MBh. xii, 6020.
अभि-√ शप् P. to curse, MBh. &c.: Caus. (ind.p. -शाप्य) to conjure, implore with solemnity, Yājñ. ii, 108.
a: अभिशप् — {c1c} U. To curse, execrate; अभिशप्तः फलमेतदन्वभूत् Ku. 4. 41. --Caus. To conjure, invoke (as by charms), charm, enchant; सत्येन माभिरक्ष त्वं वरुणेत्यभिशाप्य कं Y. 2. 108.

s: klI, (aBi + Sap + BAve lyuw .) miTyABiSaMsanaM । aBiSApaH । aBipUrvvaSapaDAtorBAve'naw ॥
m: अभि-शपन n. false accusation, calumny, L.
a: अभिशपनं --शापः — 1 A curse, imprecation. --2 A serious charge, accusation; Y. 2. 99; अभिशापः पातकाभियोगः Mit. --3 Slander, calumny, false charge; असतो दोषस्य अध्याहारोऽ भिशापः. --4 An injury, hurt. --Comp. --ज्वरः fever caused by the pronunciation of a curse.

s: tri, (aBi + Sap + ktaH .) prAptABiSApaH । SApagrastaH । yaTA, -- “na nAmagrahaRaM kuryyAt kfpaRasya gurostaTA । BAryyAyA aBiSaptasya janakasya viSezataH” ॥ iti meGadUtawIkA ॥ (“na kruDyatyapiSapto'pi kroDanIyAni varjjayan” । iti rAmAyaRe । “aTa tena nigfhya vikriyAmaBiSaptaH PalametadanvaBUt” । iti kumArasamBave .)
v: aBiSapta
tri॰ aBi + Sapa--kta । idaM te'nizwaM BUyAdityevaM rUpasya guruviprAdyaBiSApasya uddeSye । “na nAma grahaRaM kuryyAt janakasya gurostaTA । BAryyAyA aBiSaptasya kfpaRasya viSe zata” iti zurA॰ ।
m: अभि-शप्त mfn. cursed, accursed, calumniated, reviled, defamed, MBh.; Hariv. &c. [often v.l. अभिशस्त] (cf. मिथ्याभिशप्त.)

v: aBiSas
tri॰ aBi + Sansa--kvip । aBiSaMsanakarttari “yadASaMsA niHSasABiSasA” f॰ 10, 164, 3 ।
m: अभि-शस् (only instr. -शसा) f. accusation, imprecation, RV. x, 164, 3.
a: अभिशस् — {c1c} P. To hurt, injure, attack (= अभिशंस् q. v.). --f. Ved. Accusation, charge, imprecation &c.

s: tri, (aBi + Sansa + ktaH .) parastriyAM parapuruze vA mETunaM prati miTyAdUzitaH । mETunaM prati AhUtaH । iti kecit । upapannapAtakaH । iti kecit । miTyAdUzitamAtraM । iti kecit । iti BarataH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । AkzAritaH 2 kzAritaH 3 । ityamaraH ॥ (prAptApavAdaH । aBipakruzwaH । “vatsasya hyaBiSastasya purA BrAtrA yavIyasA । nAgnirdadAha romARi satyena jagataH spfSaH” ॥ iti manuH । vininditaH । vigarhitaH । pAtakakarttA । “pAparogyaBiSastaSca dAmBiko rasavikrayIH” । iti manuH .)
v: aBiSasta

tri॰ aBi + Sansa--kta । ayaM parastriyaM gacCatItyAdinA miTyAvAkyena mETunavizayakadozAropo yasmin jane kftaH tasmin । “aBiSasto mfzA kfcCraM caredAgneya meva vA” yA॰ । “niyamya prayatovAcamaBiSastAMstu varjjayet” smftiH । aBi + Sasa--baDe kta । 3 hiMsite 2 AkrAnte ca tri॰ । “AturAmaBiSastAM vA cOravyAGrAdiBirBayEH” manuH । “aBiSastAmAkrAntAmiti” prA॰ ta॰ raGu॰ । uBayataH BAve--kta 4 AkoSe, 5 apavAdakaTane 6 hiMsane 7 aBiSApe ca na॰ । “evaYcEva naraSrezWaH rakzyA eva dvijAtayaH । SAparADAnapi hi tAn vizayAnte samutsfjet aBiSastamapi hyezAM kfpAyota viSAmpate” ! BA॰ SA॰ pa॰ ।
m: अभि-शस्त mfn. accused, blamed, calumniated
defamed, infamous, MBh. &c.
threatened, Mn. xi, 112
See also s.v.
अभि-शस्त mfn. perf. Pass. p. fr. अभि-√ शंस्, q.v., but sometimes (e.g. Comm. on MBh. v, 1277 and on Mn. xii, 112) derived fr. अभि-√ शस्, which does not occur.
a: अभिशस्त — p. p. 1 Charged, falsely accused, calumniated, abused, insulted; Ms. 8. 116, 373; Y. 1. 161. --2 Hurt, injured, attacked (supposed to be from अभिशस्); देवि केनाभिशस्तासि केन वासि विमानिता Rām.; Ms. 11. 113 threatened. --3 Cursed (for अभिशप्त). --4 Wicked, sinful, infamous. --स्तं = अभशस्ति q. v.
अभिशस्त — p. p. Hurt, attacked.

k.v: आक्षारितः क्षारितोऽभिशस्ते सङ्कसुकोऽस्थिरे। व्यसनार्तोपरक्तौ द्वौ विहस्तव्याकुलौ समौ॥

v: aBiSastaka
tri॰ aBiSaste aBiSApe BavaH kan । vEdyakokte aBiSApajajvarAdO “vfttA ye devadrohABiSastakA aTarvakftA upasargakftASca” suSrutaH ।
m: अभि-शस्तक mfn. accused, defamed, Yājñ.
caused by imprecation (as a disease), Suśr.
a: अभिशस्तक — a. 1 Falsely accused, defamed; wicked; Y. 1. 223; a person of bad repute; 2. 70. --2 Caused by imprecation or curse.

m: अभि-शस्तेन्य &c. See अन्-अभिशस्त.

a: अभिशस्तृ — m. An enemy, injurer.

s: strI, (aBi + Sansa + BAve ktin .) lokApavAdaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (“syamantakaM ca satrAjitAya dattvA miTyABiSastiviSudDam avApa” । iti vizRupurARe .) yAcYA । ityamaraH ॥
v: aBiSasti

strI aBi + Sansa--ktin । 1 aBiSApe “uruzyA Ro aBiSasteH somaH” f॰ 1, 91, 15 । aBiSasteraBiSAparUpAnnindanAt” BA॰ । 2 apavAde “imAM miTyABiSastiYca kfzRasya samudAhfttAm” ha॰ vaM॰ । aBi + Sasa baDe BAve ktin । 3 hiMsAyAM “titikzante aBiSastiM janAnAm” f॰ 3, 30, 1 । “aBiSastiM hiMsAm” BA॰ । Sasyate hiMsyate'nena karaRe ktin । 4 hiMsAhetO, “purA tasyA aBiSasteraDIhi” f॰ 1, 71, 10 “aBiSasteH hiMsAhetoH” BA॰ । ABimuKyena SastiryyAcanam । 5 prArTanAyAm ।
m: अभि-शस्ति f. curse, imprecation, damnation, RV.; AV.
effect of imprecation, misfortune, evil, RV.; VS.
one who curses or injures, RV.; AV.
blame, ŚBr.
‘accusation’ (ifc.; see मिथ्याभिशस्ति)
calumny, defamation, L.
asking, begging, L.
a: अभिशस्तिः — f. 1 A curse. --2 Effect of an imprecation, misfortune, evil, calamity. --3 Censure, calumny, abuse, defamation, charge, insult. --4 Asking, begging. --5 What curses or injures; the cause or source of injury.

k.v: पर्येषणा परीष्टिश्चान्वेषणा च गवेषणा। सनिस्त्वध्येषणा याच्ञाभिशस्तिर्याचनार्थना॥

m: अभि-शस्ति—चातन mfn. keeping off imprecation, RV. iii, 3, 6.
अभि-शस्ति—कृत् mfn. accusing, ĀpŚr.
अभि-शस्ति—पा mfn. defending from imprecations, RV.; VS.; AV.
अभि-शस्ति—पावन् mfn. id., RV.; VS.

v: aBiSastya
tri॰ aBiSastimarhati yat । 1 hiMsArhe 2 AkroSArhe ca

m: अभि-शत्रु ind. against the enemy, Śiś.
अभि-√ श्चुत् Caus. P. (aor. -अचुश्चुतत्) to sprinkle with, KātyŚr.; Kauś. : Ā. to scatter over one's self, cover one's self with (instr.), Kauś.
अभि-√ शिक्ष् Caus. to teach (with acc.), MBh. i, 8033; (with double acc.), Hariv. 4910.

v: aBiSirogra
tri॰ SirasoBimuKamagraM yasya । 1 UrdDa mUlAGogre “ozaDe । trAyasvEnamiti sapta darBapiYjalIrdakziRasyAM kapuzRikAyAmaBiSirogrA upadaniGAti” go॰ । aBiSirogrAH UrdDamUlADogrAH saM॰ ta॰ raGunandanaH ।
m: अभि-शिरोऽग्र mfn. turned with the points towards the head, Gobh.
a: अभिशिरोग्र — a. With the top and bottom inverted.
अभिश्लेषणं — A bandage.

m: अभि-√ श्नथ् to pierce through, (Ved. Inf. [abl.] -श्नथः [with अबिभेत्, he was afraid] of being pierced through), RV. x, 138, 5; (Gmn., combining अभि-श्नथः with वज्रात्, takes अभिश्नथ् as an adj. ‘piercing through, killing’).
अभि-शोभित mfn. adorned, looking bright or smart, Hariv.; Kathās.
अभि-शोच mfn. shining, glowing with heat, AV. iv, 37, 10.
a: अभिशोच — a. 1 Shining, glowing with heat. --2 Causing great grief.

m: अभि-शोचन n. a tormenting spirit or demon, AV. ii, 4, 2 and iv, 9, 5.
a: अभिशोचनं — 1 Intense grief or pain, torment. --2 That which torments; a spirit or demon.

m: अभि-शोचयिष्णु mfn. causing heat or torments, AV. vi, 20, 3.
a: अभिशोचयिष्णु — a. Tormenting.

v: aBiSoka
pu॰ aBilakzya SokaH । kaYcidaBilakzIkftya kfte Soke । Suca--lyuw । aBiSocanamapyatra na॰ ।
m: अभि-शोक m. ardour, AV. i, 25, 3.
a: अभिशोकः — 1 Intense grief. --2 Warmth; ardour (Ved.).

v: aBiSrA(Sra)va
pu॰ aBi + Sru--ap vede GaY । aBitaH SravaRe “ftaM dive tadavocaM pfTivyAmaBiSrAvAya” SrutiH ।
m: अभि-श्राव m. hearing (a prayer), granting an answer, RV. i, 185, 10 and x, 12, 1.
a: अभिश्रावः — Hearing; becoming renowned.

m: 1. अभि-श्री mfn. (Ved. du. -श्रिया) attached to each other, RV. i, 144, 6; AV. viii, 2, 14
arranging, putting in order (with acc.), TBr.
अभि-श्री (ईस्), m. (or f., RV. x, 130, 5). one who arranges, puts or keeps in order, RV.
2. अभि-√ श्री (3. pl. -श्रीणन्ति, p. -श्रीणत्; plusq. 3. pl. -अशिश्रयुः) to mix, mingle, RV.; -श्रीणाति, ‘to prepare or dress’, produce, cause, TBr.; (by, BR. placed under अभि-√ श्रि.)
3. अभि-श्री nom. pl. -श्रियस् f. anything added by mingling, RV. ix, 79, 5 and 86, 27.
a: अभिश्री — a. Ved. 1 Joining, connected with, mixing. --2 Combining; arranging. --3 Approaching, having recourse to. --4 Worthy. --5 Shining. --6 Powerful.

m: अभि-श्रद्-√ धा to believe in, Vajracch.
अभि-श्रवण n. repeating Vedic texts (while sitting down to a Śrāddha), L.
a: अभिश्रवणं — Repeating Vedic texts, while Brāhmaṇas are sitting down to a Śrāddha.

m: अभि-√ श्रि (aor. -अश्रैत्) to spread, extend (as brightness), AV. xiii, 2, 9; (perf. 3. pl. -शिश्रियुः) to resort to, MBh. i, 8274.
अभि-श्रिष् (abl. -श्रिषस्) f. a ligature, RV. viii, 1, 12.
a: अभिश्रिष् --श्लिष् — f. --(ट्) Ved. A ligature.

m: अभि-√ श्रु (p. -शृण्वत्) to hear, learn, Hariv. 4583; BhP.
अभि-श्रुत mf(आ)n. renowned, AV. vi, 138, 1.
अभि-श्रुत्य ind.p. hearing of, learning, MBh. i, 4427.
अभि-√ शुभ् Ā. (part. f. -शुम्भमाना) to adorn one's self with (acc.), RV. i, 92, 10; (3. pl. -शोभन्ते) to be bright, Hariv.
1. अभि-√ 1. शुच् to mourn, MBh. xii, 11242.

2. अभि-√ 2. शुच् (Imper. -शोचतु; Subj. 2. sg. -शोचस्) to flame towards, burn, consume, RV.; VS.; KātyŚr.; to burn, torment, AV.; VS.; KātyŚr.: Caus. (aor. Subj. 3. pl. -शूशुचन्) to burn, consume (by fire), VS.; TS. : Intens. (p. -शोशुचान) id., RV. x, 87, 9 and 14.
अभि-शुन mfn. successful, having an advantage over (as one wrestler over another), TBr.
अभि-श्वास m. blowing (into a flame), KātyŚr.
a: अभिश्वासः — Breathing or blowing upon; blowing into a flame.

v: aBiSvEtya
tri॰ aBitaH SvEtyaM SudDacAritryAdasya । SudDacarite “adakziRamayajjvAnamaBiSvEtyeti vyAharan” BA॰ dro॰ pa॰

m: अभि-√ श्वस् (p. -श्वसत्; Ved. Inf. (abl.) -श्वसस्) to blow towards or hither, RV. i, 140, 5 and 92, 8; (p. -श्वसत्) to whistle, R.; to groan, R.
a: अभिश्वस् — m. Ved. One who breathes upon or towards.
अभिश्वसः — Ved. Breathing forth or upon, eructation (of the stomach).

m: अभि-श्यात and -श्यान See अभि-शीत and -शीन.
